title: Understanding Bias in Ensemble Models
text: When you average predictions from multiple models, think about how each model's errors might cancel each other out. This can affect the overall bias of the ensemble model. Consider how combining different perspectives might lead to a more balanced prediction.

title: Exploring Variance in Ensemble Models
text: Consider how variance is affected when you average predictions from multiple models. Each model might have its own fluctuations, but when combined, these fluctuations might reduce. Think about how this impacts the overall stability of the predictions.
